description: Characterizing the seismic behavior of a base-isolated generation IV reactor is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Andrew Whittaker, University at Buffalo (buffalo.edu). A set of earthquake-simulator experiments was conducted on a scale model of a base-isolated, fluoride-salt cooled, high temperature reactor. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Molten salt reactors, pebble-bed reactors, graphite reflector, seismic behavior, fluid structure interaction, base isolation. Published 2023-02-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
